title: Fixed-presentation realization of completed open projection restriction
statement: Use the finite-type open setting, augmented tensor data q and fixed Open data od of [def-sf-open-factor-fixed-data]. Given the Roos completion of the augmented tensor square in [lem-sf-open-projection-roos-completion], both q.tensorX.chi and q.tensorU.chi are invertible on every constructible pair. There is an ambient natural completed tensor/restriction isomorphism, whose quotient-unit equation is restriction_unit and whose restriction of gamma is gamma_restriction with precisely od.restrictionIso. These are equations of actual completed morphisms. This statement constructs neither Open data nor a Cartesian exchange. The signatures also use [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], [def-sf-pull-completion-comparison], [def-sf-tensor-completion-comparison], [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], [lem-sf-open-tensor-quotient-augmentation].

proof.text: Transport the normalized open coefficient identifications and the ordinary total-tensor comparison. The inverse-unit transpose identifies the ordinary map with openProjectionIso; the representative and augmentation equations identify its completion with the displayed gamma.

Constructible tensor completion identifies the two-coordinate normalized chi with its invertible quotient-unit map on all constructible pairs. Restrict the entire strict quotient tensor system to obtain the ambient tensorRestriction and its unit equation.

Restrict the completed projection square. The ordinary inverse open-unit transpose restricts to identity. Restricted product comparison is identity on every projection, and the Roos comparison is identity on both coordinates. Cancel the invertible chi maps, obtaining exactly gamma_restriction.

theorem openFactorProjectionRealization
    {U X : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (SX : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E X)
    (SU : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E U)
    (o : IntegralOpenReduction.Operations l E j)
    (st : IntegralOpenReduction.TensorComparison l E j o)
    (AX : OpenSemilinearTensor.OrdinaryReduction l E X)
    (AU : OpenSemilinearTensor.OrdinaryReduction l E U)
    (m : OpenSemilinearTensor.Comparison l E j o SX SU AX AU st)
    (c : IntegralOpenReduction.Comparison l E j o SX SU st)
    (q : OpenTensorQuotient.Comparison l E j o SX SU AX AU st m c)
    (F : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ F.p)
    [U.Over (Spec (.of F.k))] [X.Over (Spec (.of F.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (U ↘ Spec (.of F.k))] [QuasiCompact (U ↘ Spec (.of F.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of F.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of F.k))]
    [j.IsOver (Spec (.of F.k))]
    (od : Open l E j)
    (hc : OpenProjectionRoos.Completion l E j o SX SU AX AU st m c q) :
    (∀ M N : D l E X, sfIntegralConstructible l E X M →
      sfIntegralConstructible l E X N → IsIso ((q.tensorX.chi l E).app (M, N))) ∧
    (∀ M N : D l E U, sfIntegralConstructible l E U M →
      sfIntegralConstructible l E U N → IsIso ((q.tensorU.chi l E).app (M, N))) ∧
    ∃ r : integralCompletedTensor.{u, u} l E X ⋙ star l E j ≅
        ((star l E j).prod (star l E j)) ⋙ integralCompletedTensor.{u, u} l E U,
      (∀ M N : D l E X, sfIntegralConstructible l E X M →
        sfIntegralConstructible l E X N →
        (star l E j).map ((q.tensorX.chi l E).app (M, N)) ≫ r.hom.app (M, N) =
          (proEtaleCanonicalTensorComparison j ((completed l E).ring X)
            ((completed l E).ring U) ((completed l E).pull j)
            q.tensorX.ordinary q.tensorU.ordinary).hom.app (M, N) ≫
              (q.tensorU.chi l E).app ((star l E j).obj M, (star l E j).obj N)) ∧
      (∀ (K : D l E U) (P : D l E X), sfIntegralConstructible l E U K →
        sfIntegralConstructible l E X P →
        (star l E j).map (gamma l E od q.tensorU q.tensorX K P) ≫
            od.restrictionIso.hom.app ((integralCompletedTensor.{u, u} l E U).obj
              (K, (star l E j).obj P)) =
          r.hom.app ((J l E j).obj K, P) ≫
            (integralCompletedTensor.{u, u} l E U).map
              (Prod.mkHom (od.restrictionIso.hom.app K) (𝟙 _)))
